newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde April 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde April 21.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- President Jacques Chirac is expected to announce a dissolution of National Assembly tonight on television, with the aim of building a new majority to implement the shift to a single European currency. Programme to includes lower taxes, a reduced role of the state in the economy, the need to meet European timetables in a strong position and an increased emphasis on Republican values.
-- Social Security deficit may reach some 50 billion francs for 1997, similar to 1996 levels.
-- Industry Minister Franck Borotra said there would be no change in the France Telecom privatisation schedule, which is to open on May 5.

-- A boom in the satellite market is to speed up the industrialisation of manufacturing processes, as strong growth in telecommunications and television markets has allowed U.S. firms to cut production time and costs. Aerospatiale and Matra Marconi Space may seek alliances, while the outcome of Thomson-CSF privatisation is expected to be an important element in the restructuring of the industry in Europe.
-- Consumer spending from people over 50 is expected to develop strongly, according to study.
